notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 – Camera Sync & UI Fixes
notes.notes: [p][b]Bugfixes & Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera could desync from the golf ball during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug causing control hint icons to not display in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the "Custom Items" and "Custom Holes" buttons to prevent access to unfinished or unavailable content in the demo.[/p][/*][/list]
